reaction: The result matches what I expected.
reason: Fitting the cover to the planted potato trough is the only available combination and should address the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the cover to shield the developing tubers from light.

effect: The cover shields the developing tubers while leaving the shoots exposed to light and allowing the bed to drain and breathe. The final goal is complete.
reaction: I appreciated the detail that the cover protects the root space without blocking the shoots.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the potato cover was the most worthwhile action because it showed how to protect the developing tubers while keeping light on the shoots and preserving drainage and airflow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the opaque cover was a predictable, brief step, with little detail about the construction itself.

surprise.text: I learned that new potato tubers form below the granules while the shoots rise above them, and that the cover can shade the root space while leaving the shoots in light.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although combining the foil and fabric was suggested by compatibility before I knew exactly how the cover would work.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the crops develop and learn more about living on Mars, though this chapter offered few meaningful choices after the initial planting options.
